builds.name: Force of Will: AP-scaled true bonus
builds.summary: Investigate high upgraded Force of Will magic and true packets output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high upgraded Force of Will magic and true packets output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The throw helper is 190 + 0.65 AP at rank 5. Its upgraded true-damage helper multiplies that base by 0.12 + 0.0002 AP, so AP raises both the base and the bonus fraction. This creates a nonlinear AP incentive. Magic penetration affects the magic throw only; eligibility of low-health true amplification needs its own observation. Read the cross-spell upgrade binding before asserting an exact result.
